hypothesis_title: Newton's cooling law for coffee: 30-minute error

strands.why: Eight-curve held-out set assembled, no fits run; Langer 65 C crossing-time conflict unresolved. Data/bookkeeping only, not a test.
C0 in-sample RMS 1.07 K (T_room 20 C); C1 0.36 K, permutation p=0.01. One curve, gate failed, x unstable 1.50-1.94.
Web screen: no verified source gives a 30-min coffee accuracy figure or humidity/mass-loss series. Absence only, no numbers.

hypothesis_title: Refit Newton cooling for coffee, 30 minutes

strands.why: Dataset only: one coffee curve (29 pts, Sedlacek) digitized. No fit or test run; no humidity or mass series. Bookkeeping, not a test.
Frozen transfer fails: held-out RMS Manitoba C0 3.45 K vs C1 2.66 K; Langer mean 9.15 vs 9.06 K. 0.5 K bar missed by far; C1 gain p=0.0625.
Refit C0 (0-10 min to score 10-30 min): 0.64 K mean over 11 curves. Nonlinear x=2.18 gives 0.60 K, beats C0 on 2 of 11. Gate failed; one coffee curve.
